description_en: View the Data Lakehouse Edition clusters in the destination region
description_zh: 查看目标地域下的湖仓版集群列表信息
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-db-clusters --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-ids amv-bp1r053byu48p0000 --db-cluster-description test --db-cluster-status Running --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --resource-group-id rg-4690g379290000 --tag Value=test1 Key=tag1 --product-version BasicVersion --db-cluster-version 5.0 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusters

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html operation to query the IDs of available regions
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html接口查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

If you omit this parameter, the operation returns information about all clusters in the specified region
parameters.help_zh:
湖仓版集群ID。

此参数不填写时，默认返回该地域中所有集群的信息
parameters.name: db_cluster_ids

parameters.help_en:
The cluster description.

Cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters long
parameters.help_zh:
集群描述。
不能以`http://`或者`https://`开头。
长度为2~256个字符
parameters.name: db_cluster_description

parameters.help_en:
The cluster status. Valid values:

Preparing: The cluster is preparing.

Creating: The cluster is being created.

Running: The cluster is running.

Deleting: The cluster is being deleted.

Restoring: The cluster is being restored from a backup.

ClassChanging: The cluster specifications are changing.

NetAddressCreating: A network connection is being created for the cluster.

NetAddressDeleting: The network connection of the cluster is being deleted.

NetAddressModifying: The network connection of the cluster is being modified
parameters.help_zh:
集群状态，取值说明：
Preparing：准备中。
Creating：创建中。
Running：运行中。
Deleting：删除中。
Restoring：备份恢复中。
ClassChanging：变配中。
NetAddressCreating：创建网络中。
NetAddressDeleting：删除网络中。
NetAddressModifying：修改网络中
parameters.name: db_cluster_status

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

30 (default)

50

100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的正整数。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. If you omit this parameter, the operation returns information about clusters in all resource groups
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。
此参数不填写时，默认返回集群中所有资源组信息
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The tags to filter clusters by
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The product version. Valid values:

EnterpriseVersion: Enterprise edition.

BasicVersion: Basic edition.

If you omit this parameter, the operation returns clusters of all product versions
parameters.help_zh:
产品版本：
EnterpriseVersion：企业版。
BasicVersion：基础版。
选填参数，不填时默认返回全部集群
parameters.name: product_version

parameters.help_en:
The cluster version. Valid values:

3.0: Data Warehouse edition.

5.0 (default): Includes the Lakehouse, Enterprise, and Basic editions.

All: All editions, including the Data Warehouse, Lakehouse, Enterprise, and Basic editions
parameters.help_zh:
集群版本
3.0：数仓版。
5.0（默认值）：包括湖仓版、企业版和基础版。
All：所有版本，包括数仓版、湖仓版、企业版和基础版
parameters.name: db_cluster_version

Category.description_en:
The edition of the cluster. This parameter is returned only for clusters in Data Warehouse Edition. Valid values:

BASIC: Basic Edition in reserved mode.

CLUSTER: Cluster Edition in reserved mode.

MIXED_STORAGE: Elastic Mode Cluster Edition (New).

For more information about cluster editions, see [Product editions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205001.html）
Category.description_zh:
产品系列，仅在实例为数仓版时该值有意义，取值说明：
BASIC：预留模式基础版。
CLUSTER：预留模式集群版。
MIXED_STORAGE：弹性模式集群版（新版）。
更多关于集群系列的介绍，请参见[产品系列]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205001.html）

CommodityCode.description_en:
The commodity code of the cluster. Valid values:

ads: a pay-as-you-go cluster.

ads_pre: a subscription cluster
CommodityCode.description_zh:
商品付费类型，取值说明：
ads：按量付费商品。
ads_pre：包年包月商品

ComputeResource.description_en: The amount of reserved computing resources. An AnalyticDB Compute Unit (ACU) is equivalent to 1 vCPU and 4 GB of memory. Computing resources are used for data computation. You can increase computing resources to accelerate queries and elastically scale them based on the cluster performance
ComputeResource.description_zh: 计算预留资源规格。1 ACU约等于1核4 GB。计算资源用于数据计算，增加计算资源能加快查询速度，可以根据集群实际性能按需弹性扩缩

ConnectionString.description_en: The public endpoint of the cluster

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the cluster. The time is in UTC and formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

DBClusterId.description_en: The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster

DBClusterNetworkType.description_en: The network type of the cluster. The only supported network type is VPC
DBClusterNetworkType.description_zh: 集群网络类型。仅支持VPC（专有网络）类型

DBClusterStatus.description_en:
The status of the cluster. Valid values:

Preparing: The cluster is being prepared.

Creating: The cluster is being created.

Running: The cluster is running.

Deleting: The cluster is being deleted.

Restoring: The cluster is being restored from a backup.

ClassChanging: The cluster specifications are being changed.

NetAddressCreating: A network connection is being created.

NetAddressDeleting: A network connection is being deleted.

NetAddressModifying: A network connection is being modified
DBClusterStatus.description_zh:
集群状态，取值说明：
Preparing：准备中。
Creating：创建中。
Running：运行中。
Deleting：删除中。
Restoring：备份恢复中。
ClassChanging：变配中。
NetAddressCreating：创建网络中。
NetAddressDeleting：删除网络中。
NetAddressModifying：修改网络中

DBClusterType.description_en: The type of the cluster. A value of Common indicates a regular cluster
DBClusterType.description_zh: 集群类型。默认返回Common，表示常规集群

DBNodeClass.description_en: The node specification. This parameter is returned only for clusters in Data Warehouse Edition
DBNodeClass.description_zh: 节点规格，仅在实例为数仓版时该值有意义

DBNodeStorage.description_en: The storage capacity of the cluster. Unit: GB

DBVersion.description_en: The database engine version. The only supported version is 5.0
DBVersion.description_zh: 数据库版本，当前仅支持5.0版本

DiskType.description_en:
The disk type of the cluster. Valid values:

local_ssd: local SSD.

cloud: standard cloud disk.

cloud_ssd: SSD cloud disk.

cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.

cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD.

cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD.

cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD.

For more information about ESSDs, see [ESSD specifications]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html）
DiskType.description_zh:
集群的磁盘类型，取值说明：
local_ssd：本地磁盘。
cloud：普通云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_essd：PL1等级的ESSD云盘。
cloud_essd2：PL2 等级的ESSD云盘。
cloud_essd3：PL3 等级的ESSD云盘。
更多关于ESSD云盘的详情，请参见[ESSD云盘规格]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html）

DtsJobId.description_en: The ID of the Data Transmission Service (DTS) synchronization task. This parameter is returned only for MySQL analysis instances.<props="china"> For more information, see [Overview of MySQL analysis instances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154779.html）.</props>
DtsJobId.description_zh: DTS同步任务ID。仅MySQL分析实例会返回该参数。<props="china"><ph>更多详情，请参见[MySQL分析实例简介]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154779.html）。</ph></props>

ElasticIOResource.description_en:
The number of Elastic IO Units (EIUs). For more information, see [EIU details]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189505.html）.

This parameter is returned only for clusters in elastic mode
ElasticIOResource.description_zh:
弹性IO资源（Elastic IO Unit，简称EIU），更多详情，请参见[EIU详解]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189505.html）。
仅弹性模式集群会返回该参数

Engine.description_en: The database engine of the cluster. The value is fixed as AnalyticDB

ExecutorCount.description_en: The number of compute nodes in an elastic mode cluster
ExecutorCount.description_zh: 弹性模式下集群使用的计算节点数量

ExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the cluster. The time is in UTC and formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

If the cluster has a subscription billing method, the actual expiration time is returned.

If the cluster has a pay-as-you-go billing method, no value is returned
ExpireTime.description_zh: 集群到期时间，UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。 若集群付费类型为包年包月，则返回实际到期时间。 若集群付费类型为按量付费，则返回为空

Expired.description_en:
Indicates whether the subscription cluster has expired. Valid values:

true: The cluster has expired.

false: The cluster has not expired.

If a subscription cluster expires, it is locked and may be released after a period of time. We recommend that you renew the cluster. For more information, see [Renewal]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135246.html）.

This parameter is not returned for pay-as-you-go clusters
Expired.description_zh:
包年包月集群是否过期。取值说明：
true：已过期。
false：未过期。

如果集群已过期，在一定时间内集群会被锁定甚至释放。建议您进行续费操作，详情请参见[续费说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135246.html）。
按量付费集群不返回此参数

InnerIp.description_en: The internal IP address of the cluster

InnerPort.description_en: The internal port of the cluster

LockMode.description_en:
The lock state of the cluster. Valid values:

Unlock: The cluster is not locked.

ManualLock: The cluster is manually locked.

LockByExpiration: The cluster is automatically locked upon expiration
LockMode.description_zh:
集群的锁定状态，取值说明： 
Unlock：未锁定。 
ManualLock：手动触发锁定。 
LockByExpiration：集群过期自动锁定

LockReason.description_en:
The reason that the cluster is locked.

This parameter is returned only when the cluster is locked. The value is fixed as instance_expired
LockReason.description_zh:
集群锁定原因。
仅当集群被锁定时会返回该参数，固定为instance_expire

Mode.description_en: The mode of the cluster. A value of flexible indicates that the cluster is in elastic mode
Mode.description_zh: 集群模式。默认返回flexible，表示弹性模式集群

PayType.description_en:
The billing method of the cluster. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.

Prepaid: subscription
PayType.description_zh:
集群付费类型，取值说明：
Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：包年包月

Port.description_en: The port number of the cluster

ProductForm.description_en:
The product form. Valid values:

LegacyForm: The legacy form.

IntegrationForm: The integrated form
ProductForm.description_zh:
产品形态枚举：
LegacyForm: 传统形态。
IntegrationForm：融合形态

ProductVersion.description_en:
The product version. Valid values:

BasicVersion: Basic Edition.

EnterpriseVersion: Enterprise Edition
ProductVersion.description_zh:
产品版本。取值为：
BasicVersion：基础版。
EnterpriseVersion：企业版

RdsInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. This parameter is returned only for MySQL analysis instances.<props="china"> For more information, see [Overview of MySQL analysis instances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154779.html）.</props>
RdsInstanceId.description_zh: 同步源RDS实例ID。仅MySQL分析实例会返回该参数。<props="china"><ph>更多详情，请参见[MySQL分析实例简介]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154779.html）。</ph></props>

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the cluster resides

ReservedACU.description_en: The amount of remaining reserved computing resources. An ACU is equivalent to 1 vCPU and 4 GB of memory
ReservedACU.description_zh: 集群剩余可分配计算预留资源。1 ACU约等于1核4 GB

ReservedNodeCount.description_en: The number of reserved resource nodes

ReservedNodeSize.description_en: The resource specification of a single reserved node

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

StorageResource.description_en: The amount of reserved storage resources. An AnalyticDB Compute Unit (ACU) is equivalent to 1 vCPU and 4 GB of memory. Storage resources are used for data read and write operations. Increasing storage resources can improve the read and write performance of the cluster
StorageResource.description_zh: 存储预留资源规格。1 ACU约等于1核4 GB。存储资源用于数据读写，增加该资源能提高集群读写能力

Key.description_en:
The tag key.

You can call the [TagResources]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179253.html） operation to add tags to the cluster
Key.description_zh:
标签键。
您可以调用[TagResources]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179253.html）接口为目标集群创建标签

Progress.description_en: The task progress, specified as a percentage

Status.description_en:
The status of the task. Valid values:

NOT_RUN: The task is pending.

RUNNING: The task is running.

SUCCEED: The task is complete
Status.description_zh:
任务状态，取值为：
NOT_RUN：等待运行。
RUNNING：运行中。
SUCCEED：已结束

EndTime.description_en: The time when the step ended. The time is formatted as YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
EndTime.description_zh: 步骤结束时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

StartTime.description_en: The time when the step started. The time is formatted as YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
StartTime.description_zh: 步骤开始时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

StepProgress.description_en: The progress of the step, specified as a percentage

StepStatus.description_en:
The status of the step. Valid values:

NOT_RUN: The step is pending.

RUNNING: The step is running.

SUCCEED: The step is complete
StepStatus.description_zh:
步骤状态，取值为：
NOT_RUN：等待运行。
RUNNING：运行中。
SUCCEED：已结束

ZoneId.description_en: The ID of the zone where the cluster resides

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
